===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A positive integer that can be divided by two, and two itself.
# {{lb|en|mathematics}} An integer that is divisible by two.
# {{&lit|en|even|number}} {{gloss|a number that is equal or equivalent}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1866|author=Israel Gibbons|title=Crescent-shine|page=108
|passage=If you'd come at me with '''even numbers''', I wouldn't leave a [[grease spot]] of you.}}
